theorems.name: Submission.exists_finite_contDiff_partition_near_compact
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (C : Set (Rn N)) (P : Set (Rn N) → Prop), IsCompact C → (∀ y ∈ C, ∃ U : Set (Rn N), IsOpen U ∧ y ∈ U ∧ P U) → ∃ (p : ℕ) (ζ : Fin p → Rn N → ℝ) (O : Set (Rn N)), IsOpen O ∧ C ⊆ O ∧ (∀ z ∈ O, ∑ q, ζ q z = 1) ∧ ∀ q, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ζ q) ∧ HasCompactSupport (ζ q) ∧ ∃ U : Set (Rn N), P U ∧ tsupport (ζ q) ⊆ U
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
